python - <<'PY'
import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json','r') as f:
    d=json.load(f)

cpi=pd.DataFrame(d['cpi_inflation']['data'])
wag=pd.DataFrame(d['wage_growth']['data'])
fed=pd.DataFrame(d['federal_funds_rate']['data'])
real=pd.DataFrame(d['real_wage_growth']['data'])

for df in (cpi,wag,fed,real):
    df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# merge for calculations/shading intervals
m=cpi[['date','value']].rename(columns={'value':'cpi'}).merge(
    wag[['date','value']].rename(columns={'value':'wage'}), on='date').merge(
    fed[['date','value']].rename(columns={'value':'fed'}), on='date').merge(
    real[['date','value']].rename(columns={'value':'real'}), on='date')

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14,8), dpi=200)

# Editorial palette
colors={
    'cpi':'#b22222',
    'wage':'#1f5a99',
    'real':'#2e8b57',
    'fed':'#5a3d9a'
}

# Highlight peak inflation zone
peak_start=pd.Timestamp('2022-04-01')
peak_end=pd.Timestamp('2022-09-01')
ax.axvspan(peak_start, peak_end, color='#f5c6a5', alpha=0.35, zorder=0)

# Lag window (rate hikes start to clear CPI downtrend)
lag_start=pd.Timestamp('2022-03-01')
lag_end=pd.Timestamp('2022-12-01')
ax.axvspan(lag_start, lag_end, color='#d9d9d9', alpha=0.22, zorder=0)

# Real wage negative zone shading
neg = m['real'] < 0
ax.fill_between(m['date'], m['real'], 0, where=neg, color='#f4a6a6', alpha=0.45, interpolate=True, zorder=1)

# Plot lines
ax.plot(m['date'], m['cpi'], color=colors['cpi'], linewidth=2.8, label='CPI Inflation (YoY)')
ax.plot(m['date'], m['wage'], color=colors['wage'], linewidth=2.4, label='Nominal Wage Growth (YoY)')
ax.plot(m['date'], m['real'], color=colors['real'], linewidth=2.4, linestyle='--', label='Real Wage Growth (Wage − CPI)')

# Fed funds rate as step line
ax.step(m['date'], m['fed'], where='post', color=colors['fed'], linewidth=2.8, label='Federal Funds Rate (Effective)')

# Mark start of hikes
hike_start = pd.Timestamp('2022-03-01')
ax.axvline(hike_start, color=colors['fed'], linestyle=':', linewidth=1.8, alpha=0.9)
ax.text(hike_start, 9.45, 'Rate hikes begin\n(Mar 2022)', color=colors['fed'], fontsize=9, ha='left', va='top')

# Labels/title
ax.set_title('U.S. Inflation Spiral Indicators, 2021–2024\nInterplay of CPI, Wage Growth, Fed Funds Rate, and Real Wage Growth',
             fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', pad=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Month', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel('Percent (%)', fontsize=11)

# Ticks and limits
ax.set_ylim(-4.5, 10)
ax.set_xlim(m['date'].min(), m['date'].max())
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator(interval=3))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y-%m'))
plt.setp(ax.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# Annotation for CPI peak
peak_row = m.loc[m['cpi'].idxmax()]
ax.scatter([peak_row['date']], [peak_row['cpi']], color=colors['cpi'], s=30, zorder=5)
ax.annotate('CPI peak: 9.1%\n(2022-06)',
            xy=(peak_row['date'], peak_row['cpi']),
            xytext=(pd.Timestamp('2022-09-01'), 9.0),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=colors['cpi'], lw=1.2),
            fontsize=9, color=colors['cpi'])

# Annotation for real wage recovery
recovery = m[m['real']>=0].loc[m[m['real']>=0]['date']>=pd.Timestamp('2023-01-01')].iloc[0]
ax.scatter([recovery['date']], [recovery['real']], color=colors['real'], s=28, zorder=5)
ax.annotate('Real wage growth\nreturns positive',
            xy=(recovery['date'], recovery['real']),
            xytext=(pd.Timestamp('2023-07-01'), 1.9),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=colors['real'], lw=1.2),
            fontsize=9, color=colors['real'])

# Custom legend with shaded zones
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
handles += [
    Line2D([0],[0], color='#d9d9d9', lw=8, alpha=0.45),
    Line2D([0],[0], color='#f5c6a5', lw=8, alpha=0.6),
    Line2D([0],[0], color='#f4a6a6', lw=8, alpha=0.6)
]
labels += [
    'Visible policy-to-inflation lag window',
    'Mid-2022 peak inflation zone',
    'Negative real wage period'
]
leg=ax.legend(handles, labels, loc='upper right', frameon=True, framealpha=0.95, fontsize=9)
leg.get_frame().set_edgecolor('#cccccc')

ax.grid(True, axis='y', color='#e5e5e5')
ax.grid(False, axis='x')
for s in ['top','right']:
    ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=220, bbox_inches='tight')
print('saved /app/output/result.png')

python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import json, math, datetime

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    d=json.load(f)

series={
    'CPI Inflation (YoY)': d['cpi_inflation']['data'],
    'Nominal Wage Growth (YoY)': d['wage_growth']['data'],
    'Federal Funds Rate (Effective)': d['federal_funds_rate']['data'],
    'Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)': d['real_wage_growth']['data']
}

labels=[x['date'] for x in series['CPI Inflation (YoY)']]
vals={k:[p['value'] for p in v] for k,v in series.items()}

W,H=1800,1100
m_left,m_right,m_top,m_bottom=140,60,120,160
plot_w=W-m_left-m_right
plot_h=H-m_top-m_bottom

img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white')
drw=ImageDraw.Draw(img)

try:
    f_title=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',42)
    f_sub=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',24)
    f_axis=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',22)
    f_tick=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',18)
    f_leg=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',20)
except:
    f_title=f_sub=f_axis=f_tick=f_leg=ImageFont.load_default()

ymin,ymax=-4.5,10.0

def sx(i): return m_left + i*(plot_w/(len(labels)-1))
def sy(v): return m_top + (ymax-v)*(plot_h/(ymax-ymin))

# shaded windows
idx={d:i for i,d in enumerate(labels)}
# lag window
x0,x1=sx(idx['2022-03']),sx(idx['2022-12'])
drw.rectangle([x0,m_top,x1,m_top+plot_h],fill=(226,226,226))
# peak zone
x0,x1=sx(idx['2022-04']),sx(idx['2022-09'])
drw.rectangle([x0,m_top,x1,m_top+plot_h],fill=(245,214,190))

# grid and y ticks
for t in range(-4,11,2):
    y=sy(t)
    drw.line([m_left,y,m_left+plot_w,y],fill=(230,230,230),width=1)
    drw.text((m_left-55,y-10),f'{t}',font=f_tick,fill=(80,80,80))

# x ticks quarterly
for i,l in enumerate(labels):
    if l.endswith('-01') or l.endswith('-04') or l.endswith('-07') or l.endswith('-10'):
        x=sx(i)
        drw.line([x,m_top+plot_h,x,m_top+plot_h+8],fill=(120,120,120),width=1)
        drw.text((x-34,m_top+plot_h+14),l,font=f_tick,fill=(80,80,80))

# axes
drw.line([m_left,m_top,m_left,m_top+plot_h],fill=(60,60,60),width=2)
drw.line([m_left,m_top+plot_h,m_left+plot_w,m_top+plot_h],fill=(60,60,60),width=2)

colors={
 'CPI Inflation (YoY)':(178,34,34),
 'Nominal Wage Growth (YoY)':(31,90,153),
 'Federal Funds Rate (Effective)':(90,61,154),
 'Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)':(46,139,87)
}

# negative real wage area
rv=vals['Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)']
poly=[]
for i,v in enumerate(rv):
    if v<0: poly.append((sx(i),sy(v)))
if poly:
    pts=[(sx(i),sy(0)) for i,v in enumerate(rv) if v<0]
    if pts:
        drw.polygon(pts+poly[::-1],fill=(244,166,166))

# lines
for name in ['CPI Inflation (YoY)','Nominal Wage Growth (YoY)','Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)','Federal Funds Rate (Effective)']:
    points=[(sx(i),sy(v)) for i,v in enumerate(vals[name])]
    if name=='Federal Funds Rate (Effective)':
        for i in range(len(points)-1):
            x,y=points[i]; nx,ny=points[i+1]
            drw.line([x,y,nx,y],fill=colors[name],width=4)
            drw.line([nx,y,nx,ny],fill=colors[name],width=4)
    else:
        drw.line(points,fill=colors[name],width=4)

# title and labels
drw.text((m_left,30),'U.S. Inflation Spiral Indicators, 2021–2024',font=f_title,fill=(20,20,20))
drw.text((m_left,80),'Temporal interplay of CPI inflation, wage growth, federal funds rate, and real wage growth',font=f_sub,fill=(70,70,70))
drw.text((W//2-40,H-70),'Month',font=f_axis,fill=(50,50,50))
drw.text((30,m_top+plot_h//2),'Percent (%)',font=f_axis,fill=(50,50,50))

# legend
lx,ly=W-620,130
for i,name in enumerate(['CPI Inflation (YoY)','Nominal Wage Growth (YoY)','Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)','Federal Funds Rate (Effective)']):
    y=ly+i*36
    drw.line([lx,y+12,lx+46,y+12],fill=colors[name],width=5)
    drw.text((lx+58,y),name,font=f_leg,fill=(40,40,40))

# save
img.save('/app/output/result.png')
print('saved')

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import json, math, datetime

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    d=json.load(f)

series={
    'CPI Inflation (YoY)': d['cpi_inflation']['data'],
    'Nominal Wage Growth (YoY)': d['wage_growth']['data'],
    'Federal Funds Rate (Effective)': d['federal_funds_rate']['data'],
    'Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)': d['real_wage_growth']['data']
}

labels=[x['date'] for x in series['CPI Inflation (YoY)']]
vals={k:[p['value'] for p in v] for k,v in series.items()}

W,H=1800,1100
m_left,m_right,m_top,m_bottom=140,60,120,160
plot_w=W-m_left-m_right
plot_h=H-m_top-m_bottom

img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white')
drw=ImageDraw.Draw(img)

try:
    f_title=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',42)
    f_sub=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',24)
    f_axis=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',22)
    f_tick=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',18)
    f_leg=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',20)
except:
    f_title=f_sub=f_axis=f_tick=f_leg=ImageFont.load_default()

ymin,ymax=-4.5,10.0

def sx(i): return m_left + i*(plot_w/(len(labels)-1))
def sy(v): return m_top + (ymax-v)*(plot_h/(ymax-ymin))

# shaded windows
idx={d:i for i,d in enumerate(labels)}
# lag window
x0,x1=sx(idx['2022-03']),sx(idx['2022-12'])
drw.rectangle([x0,m_top,x1,m_top+plot_h],fill=(226,226,226))
# peak zone
x0,x1=sx(idx['2022-04']),sx(idx['2022-09'])
drw.rectangle([x0,m_top,x1,m_top+plot_h],fill=(245,214,190))

# grid and y ticks
for t in range(-4,11,2):
    y=sy(t)
    drw.line([m_left,y,m_left+plot_w,y],fill=(230,230,230),width=1)
    drw.text((m_left-55,y-10),f'{t}',font=f_tick,fill=(80,80,80))

# x ticks quarterly
for i,l in enumerate(labels):
    if l.endswith('-01') or l.endswith('-04') or l.endswith('-07') or l.endswith('-10'):
        x=sx(i)
        drw.line([x,m_top+plot_h,x,m_top+plot_h+8],fill=(120,120,120),width=1)
        drw.text((x-34,m_top+plot_h+14),l,font=f_tick,fill=(80,80,80))

# axes
drw.line([m_left,m_top,m_left,m_top+plot_h],fill=(60,60,60),width=2)
drw.line([m_left,m_top+plot_h,m_left+plot_w,m_top+plot_h],fill=(60,60,60),width=2)

colors={
 'CPI Inflation (YoY)':(178,34,34),
 'Nominal Wage Growth (YoY)':(31,90,153),
 'Federal Funds Rate (Effective)':(90,61,154),
 'Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)':(46,139,87)
}

# negative real wage area
rv=vals['Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)']
poly=[]
for i,v in enumerate(rv):
    if v<0: poly.append((sx(i),sy(v)))
if poly:
    pts=[(sx(i),sy(0)) for i,v in enumerate(rv) if v<0]
    if pts:
        drw.polygon(pts+poly[::-1],fill=(244,166,166))

# lines
for name in ['CPI Inflation (YoY)','Nominal Wage Growth (YoY)','Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)','Federal Funds Rate (Effective)']:
    points=[(sx(i),sy(v)) for i,v in enumerate(vals[name])]
    if name=='Federal Funds Rate (Effective)':
        for i in range(len(points)-1):
            x,y=points[i]; nx,ny=points[i+1]
            drw.line([x,y,nx,y],fill=colors[name],width=4)
            drw.line([nx,y,nx,ny],fill=colors[name],width=4)
    else:
        drw.line(points,fill=colors[name],width=4)

# title and labels
drw.text((m_left,30),'U.S. Inflation Spiral Indicators, 2021–2024',font=f_title,fill=(20,20,20))
drw.text((m_left,80),'Temporal interplay of CPI inflation, wage growth, federal funds rate, and real wage growth',font=f_sub,fill=(70,70,70))
drw.text((W//2-40,H-70),'Month',font=f_axis,fill=(50,50,50))
drw.text((30,m_top+plot_h//2),'Percent (%)',font=f_axis,fill=(50,50,50))

# legend
lx,ly=W-620,130
for i,name in enumerate(['CPI Inflation (YoY)','Nominal Wage Growth (YoY)','Real Wage Growth (Wage−CPI)','Federal Funds Rate (Effective)']):
    y=ly+i*36
    drw.line([lx,y+12,lx+46,y+12],fill=colors[name],width=5)
    drw.text((lx+58,y),name,font=f_leg,fill=(40,40,40))

# save
img.save('/app/output/result.png')
print('saved')
PY
